answer_sentences.text: Clause 9.3 in the 2026-02-10 Home Loan Agreement requires a 2% pre-payment charge on the principal outstanding for full or partial foreclosure/pre-payment.
answer_sentences.quote: 9.3 In the event of foreclosure or pre-payment of the loan, in full or in part, the Borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding.

answer_sentences.text: The provided sources also contain other versions of the clause showing a 3% pre-payment charge, so the agreement materials are inconsistent on the charge amount.
answer_sentences.quote: 9.3 In the event of foreclosure or pre-payment of the loan, in full or in part, the Borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding.

answer_sentences.text: I cannot confirm whether the 2% charge complies with the RBI’s current rules from these sources alone, because none of the provided sources states the RBI rule itself.
answer_sentences.quote: 9.1 The Borrower may pre-pay the Loan, in full or in part, at any time after giving seven days' written notice to the branch.
